passages.title: Station Notice
passages.text: Due to essential engineering work, the subway to platforms 4 and 5 is closed today. Passengers requiring step-free access should speak to a member of staff at the information desk for assistance with alternative routes.

passages.title: Airport Sign
passages.text: Unattended luggage left in the terminal building will be removed and destroyed by security. Please keep your bags with you at all times. If you see anything suspicious, report it immediately to airport police.

passages.title: Platform Announcement
passages.text: The 14:15 service to London Victoria is now delayed by 20 minutes due to a signal failure. We apologise for the inconvenience. Tickets for this train remain valid on the next available service.

passages.title: Airport Parking
passages.text: Short-stay parking is for dropping off and picking up passengers only. Vehicles left for longer than 30 minutes will be fined. Please use the long-stay car park for stays exceeding one hour.

passages.title: Train Station Shop
passages.text: We are currently looking for part-time shop assistants to work weekends. Must be available to start immediately. Please hand your CV to the manager at the station newsagent before Friday.

questions.question: What should passengers needing step-free access do?
questions.explanation: The text advises passengers to speak to staff at the information desk for help.
options: a) Use the subway to reach the platforms.
b) Ask staff for help with a different route.
c) Wait until the engineering work is finished.

questions.question: What is the warning about luggage?
questions.explanation: The sign states that unattended bags will be destroyed by security.
options: a) You should report lost bags to the police.
b) Bags left alone will be removed by security.
c) You must pay a fee to leave bags unattended.

questions.question: What does the announcement say about the train?
questions.explanation: The train is late, but tickets are still valid for later trains.
options: a) Passengers can use their current ticket on a later train.
b) The train has been cancelled due to a signal failure.
c) Passengers must buy a new ticket for the next service.

questions.question: What is the rule for short-stay parking?
questions.explanation: Vehicles staying over 30 minutes will be fined.
options: a) It is only for people who are travelling alone.
b) You can park there for up to one hour.
c) You will be charged if you stay longer than 30 minutes.

questions.question: How can you apply for the shop job?
questions.explanation: Applicants should give their CV to the manager at the newsagent.
options: a) By giving your CV to the shop manager.
b) By calling the shop before Friday.
c) By sending an email to the station office.
